answer: Approval requires signers drawn from at least three separate invitation subtrees with no shared inviter within five hops, so one farm branch can occupy only one slot in any approving panel no matter how many identities it registers. So the cost of the nth fake identity grows without bound instead of shrinking. Picture an ember with one ticket, a lotus that separates tickets from strangers, and a sparrow that tallies tickets by tree: buying more identities in one ember changes nothing about the lotus or the sparrow tally.
